title: GTA 6 Changes the Iconic Sprint Button After 25 Years
description: After nearly 25 years, Grand Theft Auto 6 is changing how sprinting works, finally moving away from the traditional button-tapping mechanic.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Quarter-Century Tradition Comes to an End

For nearly 25 years, Grand Theft Auto games have featured a very distinct control scheme that mapped sprint movement directly to a face button on a controller. For players across various platforms, getting a character to sprint at full speed traditionally required repeatedly tapping either the X or A button.

According to a recent report from gaming outlet Eurogamer, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally bucking this long-standing trend. The upcoming installment will no longer require players to frantically tap a face button just to make their character peg it across the map.

### Looking Back at the Classic Control Scheme

Ever since the franchise transitioned into full 3D environments, the repetitive tapping of a face button has been a staple of the Rockstar open-world formula. While some past Rockstar titles introduced alternate control schemes as options, the default method always remained consistent. This rhythmic button-mashing became an intrinsic part of the muscle memory for millions of gamers worldwide.

By altering this mechanic in GTA 6, Rockstar is stepping away from a standard that has defined the series for a quarter of a century.

### The Shift Toward Modern Control Standards

Industry observers and analysts note that this shift aligns with the evolution of modern control standards in open-world action games. Repetitive button-mashing can lead to hardware wear and tear as well as physical fatigue during extended play sessions. Updating the sprint mechanic is likely aimed at delivering a smoother, more ergonomically friendly traversal experience for players diving into the new world.

## Editor's Take

Changing a default control mechanic that has been part of the GTA DNA for 25 years is a bold yet welcome move. While veterans will certainly need a moment to rewrite their muscle memory, modernizing the movement system is a necessary step forward for player comfort and fluidity in GTA 6.
